Ommisa

Ommisa is the assistant of the OIML SMART programme. It answers questions about OIML Recommendations, Documents, Basic publications and Guides, and every claim in an answer carries a citation to the exact clause of the indexed publication. When the indexed corpus does not cover a question, the service states that it has no answer instead of guessing.

The three surfaces

The web application

The web application at ai.oimlsmart.org provides streaming answers with source chips, memory files that join subsequent questions as context, synchronized conversations, projects, and the confidence line under every answer. Public visitors receive a small daily question allowance, and signing in with an OIML SMART account unlocks the member tier with the programme's internal corpora.

The command-line interface

The ommisa command provides the same assistant at the terminal. It authenticates through a device code that is approved in the browser, streams the answer as it is written, and writes the reply alone to standard output so that it composes with other tools.

npm install -g @ommisa/cli
ommisa login
ommisa ask "What is the MPE requirement for a load cell per OIML R 60?"

The CLI documentation covers every command.

The API

A conversational HTTP API and an MCP server expose grounded answers, passage search and the publication registry to other programs. The developer documentation describes the endpoints and the authentication model.

Confidence is stated on every answer

Every answer carries a colored line that states how much trust the answer warrants and which sources warrant it. The confidence documentation explains the three levels and how to read a citation.

Ommisa is part of the OIML SMART programme — a public pilot. Answers are for information only; the official OIML publications govern.
